abstract: Verifies statutory environmental water discharge permits, drainage runoff thresholds, and ecological impact declarations
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your business responsibilities include verifying statutory environmental water discharge permits, drainage runoff thresholds, and ecological impact declarations, as well as conducting estuarine turbidity surveillance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies statutory environmental water discharge permits, drainage runoff thresholds, and ecological impact declarations（REG）
information_points.content:
ENV-REG-PYC：For the Demountable floodwall and tidal flap valve scheme, the statutory environmental water discharge permit is not active across candidate emergency floodwater pumping and gravity swale outfalls.
ENV-REG-M1W：For the Pneumatic crest barrier and retention swale scheme, the statutory environmental water discharge permit is active across candidate emergency floodwater pumping and gravity swale outfalls.
ENV-REG-1FH：For the Modular steel stoplog and sluice gate scheme, the statutory environmental water discharge permit is active across candidate emergency floodwater pumping and gravity swale outfalls.

information_points.title: Estuarine turbidity surveillance（TURB）
information_points.content:
ENV-TURB-4NN：Effluent water sampling logs indicate that the Pneumatic crest barrier and retention swale scheme maintains a stormwater runoff suspended solids concentration of 45 mg/L across discharge outfalls into the Humber mudflats.
ENV-TURB-T5O：Effluent water sampling logs indicate that the Demountable floodwall and tidal flap valve scheme maintains a stormwater runoff suspended solids concentration of 70 mg/L across discharge outfalls into the Humber mudflats.
ENV-TURB-TMX：Effluent water sampling logs indicate that the Modular steel stoplog and sluice gate scheme maintains a stormwater runoff suspended solids concentration of 25 mg/L across discharge outfalls into the Humber mudflats.
